acceptance_matrix.check: Submit a task, stop the process after the durable acknowledgement, reopen the store in another process, and recover the same identity, goal, state, and progress. No accepted task disappears on New chat or UI closure.

Two controllers competing for one ready task produce one execution claim. Old run generations cannot commit progress, tool outcomes, or completion after a newer claim; repeated startup recovery remains idempotent.
acceptance_matrix.existing_surface: new SQLite store and controller integration

acceptance_matrix.check: Interrupt before attempt commit, after attempt commit, and after the effect but before the outcome commit. Recovery inspects actual fixture state before repeating an effect, records an already-applied result once, and retains an explicit waiting/uncertain state when inspection cannot resolve it.
acceptance_matrix.existing_surface: new action coordinator with fake adapter + real task store

acceptance_matrix.check: A pending task-scoped question survives process restart. Only its exact current identity accepts an answer once; stale, cancelled, wrong-kind, or old-generation responses cannot affect another task. Preserve explicit approve/decline behavior and stop winning approval races.

User cancellation records a terminal cancellation and releases execution resources. Pause preserves resumable work. Graceful shutdown records interruption/checkpoint rather than user cancellation; reopening permits the intended recovery policy. Existing Stop clears queued conversation turns while retaining durable task records, and New chat clears conversation history without deleting work.

Only a fully committed and exported final transcript triggers work. Duplicate delivery, repeated startup scans, and a crash between event receipt and task submission yield one task per instruction/event identity. A schedule occurrence is also deduplicated; missed-run and recurrence semantics use explicit clock observations. Disabled instructions perform no work.

Unrelated tasks do not overwrite or leak SDK histories. Queued user requests retain invocation context. Recovery reloads the intended task context; source/freshness metadata is retained and stale observations require refresh. Browser/Teams payloads and credentials remain absent from general journals.

Two tasks cannot own foreground input at once; waiting/cancelled owners release resources. Background adapter work and keyboard handling remain independent. No agent, UI, store, or model dependency enters the layout event loop. Root owns before/after keyboard latency/allocation/GC measurements.

Task overview and voice/typed controls act on the same durable IDs and show committed status/results. Late stream/tool events cannot attach to another turn after reset or resume. Pending answers reach their question instead of accidentally starting work. Closing history does not delete tasks.
acceptance_matrix.existing_surface: tests/test_agent_window.py; test_agent_session.py; test_agent_streaming.py; new work panel tests

acceptance_matrix.check: Keeper startup/restart/install/rollback includes the worker and fresh readiness. Worker readiness follows store initialization/recovery, not external model availability. IPC validates malformed, oversized, stale, and unknown messages before effects. An isolated worker restart recovers tasks and reconnects the assistant without starting a second keyboard or using the live desktop.
acceptance_matrix.existing_surface: tests/test_keeper.py; tests/test_windows_runtime.py; new isolated worker/IPC integration

acceptance_matrix.check: Through a fake endpoint and real temporary storage, a finalized transcript creates one task, produces notes and action items with source references, verifies the saved output, and presents the completed result. Restart at an action checkpoint must not duplicate the note update.
acceptance_matrix.existing_surface: new end-to-end task + routine + adapter fixture; existing fake_endpoint.py

acceptance_matrix.check: New automation modules are discoverable by setuptools, selfcheck imports, and slots audits. Copied/extracted source starts the worker using pinned dependencies; bootstrap remains importable under system Python 3.12. Root verifies Windows source and ZIP hashes, clears replaced bytecode, preserves unchanged pins, and checks fresh child PIDs/readiness after reload.

baseline.scope: No source edits, live corporate endpoint calls, external messages, foreground input, or deployment performed.

import hashlib, json, os, sys, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
os.environ.pop("WORKSPACE_E2E",None)
sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
os.chdir(root)
from runtime import activate
activate()
import selfcheck
problems=[]
timings=[]
started=time.perf_counter()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="workspace-focused-selfcheck-") as directory:
 discovery=Path(directory)
 (discovery/"tests").mkdir()
 for name in ("test_work_acceptance.py","test_external_input.py"):
  (discovery/"tests"/name).touch()
 passed,skipped=selfcheck.run_tests(discovery,problems,timings=timings)
result={"passed":passed,"skipped_modules":skipped,"problems":problems,"seconds":round(time.perf_counter()-started,3),"timings":timings,"pytest_imported":"pytest" in sys.modules,"python":sys.version}
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if passed==8 and skipped==0 and not problems and "pytest" not in sys.modules else 1)
